segments.cp5:2.3: Tena demi mahādānaṃ, akkhobbhaṃ [akkhobhaṃ (syā. kaṃ.)] sāgarūpamaṃ.
segments.cp5:3.1: “Na me dessaṃ dhanaṃ dhaññaṃ, napi natthi nicayo mayi;
segments.cp5:3.3: Sabbaññutaṃ piyaṃ mayhaṃ, tasmā demi varaṃ dhanan”ti.

lines: Tattha tadāhanti yadā sattarājapurohito mahāgovindabrāhmaṇo homi, tadā ahaṃ.
Akkhobhanti abbhantarehi ca bāhirehi ca paccatthikehi appaṭisedhanīyatāya kenaci akkhobhanīyaṃ.
Atipuṇṇadānajjhāsayassa deyyadhammassa ca uḷārabhāvena vipulabhāvena ca ativiya paripuṇṇanti attho.
Sāgarūpamanti sāgarasadisaṃ, yathā sāgare udakaṃ sakalenapi lokena harantena khepetuṃ na sakkā, evaṃ tassa dānagge deyyadhammanti.
Osānagāthāya varaṃ dhananti uttamaṃ icchitaṃ vā dhanaṃ.
